        """)
        self.status_bar.setStyleSheet(f"background-color: {colors.get('statusbar.background', '#252525')}; border-top: 1px solid {border};")
        if hasattr(self, 'diff_viewer'): self.diff_viewer.setStyleSheet(f"background-color: {colors.get('editor.background', '#2b2b2b')};"); self._display_diff(self.changes_list.currentItem(), None)
            
    def _on_item_changed(self, item: QStandardItem):
        if self._is_updating_checks:
            return

        item_data = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        if item_data and item.checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked:
            path = item_data.get('path')
            token_count = self.folder_token_counts.get(os.path.normpath(path), 0)

            if abs(token_count) > LARGE_TOKEN_COUNT:
                item_type = "folder" if item_data.get('is_dir', False) else "file"
                token_display = f"an estimated ~{abs(token_count):,}"
                if token_count > 0: token_display = f"~{token_count:,}"
                elif token_count < 0: token_display = f"over {abs(token_count):,}"

                reply = QMessageBox.warning(
                    self, f"Large {item_type.capitalize()} Selected",
                    f"The {item_type} '{os.path.basename(path)}' is very large ({token_display} tokens) and may consume a lot of tokens, potentially increasing API costs.\n\n"
                    "Are you sure you want to include it in the context?",
                    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
                    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes
                )
                if reply == QMessageBox.StandardButton.No:
                    self._is_updating_checks = True
                    item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)
                    self._is_updating_checks = False

        self._is_updating_checks = True
        state = item.checkState()
        
        if state in (Qt.CheckState.Checked, Qt.CheckState.Unchecked):
            stack = [item.child(i) for i in range(item.rowCount())]
            while stack:
                child = stack.pop(0)
                if child and child.isCheckable() and child.isEnabled():
                    child.setCheckState(state)
                    if child.hasChildren():
                        stack.extend(child.child(j) for j in range(child.rowCount()))

        parent = item.parent()
        while parent:
            self._update_parent_checkstate(parent)
            parent = parent.parent()

        self._is_updating_checks = False
        self._update_toggle_button_state()
        self._update_total_token_count()
        self.save_selection_timer.start()

    def _update_parent_checkstate(self, parent):
        if not parent or not hasattr(parent, 'isCheckable') or not parent.isCheckable(): return

        checked_count = 0
        partially_checked_count = 0
        total_checkable_children = 0
        
        for i in range(parent.rowCount()):
            child = parent.child(i)
            if child.isCheckable() and child.isEnabled():
                total_checkable_children += 1
                state = child.checkState()
                if state == Qt.CheckState.Checked: checked_count += 1
                elif state == Qt.CheckState.PartiallyChecked: partially_checked_count += 1
        
        if total_checkable_children == 0:
            return

        new_state = Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
        if checked_count == total_checkable_children: new_state = Qt.CheckState.Checked
        elif checked_count > 0 or partially_checked_count > 0: new_state = Qt.CheckState.PartiallyChecked
            
        if parent.checkState() != new_state: parent.setCheckState(new_state)

    def _populate_file_tree(self):
        self.file_model.clear()
        self.path_to_item_map.clear()
        self.folder_token_counts.clear()
        self.total_tokens_label.setText("Selected tokens: 0")
        if not self.project_path: return

        root_node = self.file_model.invisibleRootItem()
        self.path_to_item_map = {os.path.normpath(self.project_path): root_node}
        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(self.project_path, topdown=True):
            dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d not in {'.git', '__pycache__', 'venv', '.venv'}]
            parent_node = self.path_to_item_map.get(os.path.normpath(dirpath))
            if not parent_node: continue
            for dirname in sorted(dirnames):
                dir_path = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(dirpath, dirname))
                dir_item = QStandardItem(dirname)
                dir_item.setIcon(qta.icon('fa5s.folder', color='grey'))
                dir_item.setCheckable(True)
                dir_item.setData({'path': dir_path, 'is_dir': True}, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                parent_node.appendRow(dir_item)
                self.path_to_item_map[dir_path] = dir_item
            for filename in sorted(filenames):
                file_path = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(dirpath, filename))
                is_unsupported = is_binary_file(file_path)
                file_item = QStandardItem(filename)
                
                icon_name = 'fa5s.ban' if is_unsupported else 'fa5.file-code'
                icon_color = 'red' if is_unsupported else 'grey'
                file_item.setIcon(qta.icon(icon_name, color=icon_color))

                file_item.setCheckable(not is_unsupported)
                file_item.setEnabled(not is_unsupported)
                if is_unsupported:
                    file_item.setToolTip("Binary or unsupported file type, excluded from context.")
                
                file_item.setData({'path': file_path, 'is_dir': False}, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                parent_node.appendRow(file_item)
                self.path_to_item_map[file_path] = file_item
        
        self._start_token_count_scan()
        self._update_toggle_button_state()

    def _get_all_checkable_items(self) -> List[QStandardItem]:
        items, root = [], self.file_model.invisibleRootItem()
        for i in range(root.rowCount()):
            stack = [root.child(i)]
            while stack:
                item = stack.pop(0)
                if item.isCheckable():
                    items.append(item)
                if item.hasChildren():
                    stack.extend(item.child(j) for j in range(item.rowCount()))
        return items

    def _toggle_all_files(self):
        """
        Selects all valid files if nothing is selected.
        Deselects all files if anything is selected.
        This provides a more intuitive workflow than a simple toggle.
        """
        enabled_items = [it for it in self._get_all_checkable_items() if it.isEnabled()]
        if not enabled_items:
            return
    
        is_anything_checked = any(item.checkState() != Qt.CheckState.Unchecked for item in enabled_items)
        
        # If anything is selected, the action is to deselect all.
        # If nothing is selected, the action is to select all valid files.
        new_state = Qt.CheckState.Unchecked if is_anything_checked else Qt.CheckState.Checked
    
        self._is_updating_checks = True
        root = self.file_model.invisibleRootItem()
        self._recursive_set_check_state(root, new_state)
        self._is_updating_checks = False
    
        self._update_total_token_count()
        self._update_toggle_button_state()
        self.save_selection_timer.start()

    def _recursive_set_check_state(self, parent_item: QStandardItem, state: Qt.CheckState):
        for row in range(parent_item.rowCount()):
            child = parent_item.child(row)
            if not (child and child.isCheckable() and child.isEnabled()):
                continue

            # When selecting all, skip items that are too large
            if state == Qt.CheckState.Checked:
                item_data = child.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                if item_data and (path := item_data.get('path')):
                    token_count = self.folder_token_counts.get(os.path.normpath(path), 0)
                    if abs(token_count) > SELECTION_TOKEN_THRESHOLD:
                        # Ensure it's unchecked and then skip its children
                        if child.checkState() != Qt.CheckState.Unchecked:
                             child.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)
                        continue

            if child.checkState() != state:
                child.setCheckState(state)

            if child.hasChildren():
                self._recursive_set_check_state(child, state)

    def _update_toggle_button_state(self):
        """Updates the icon and tooltip of the toggle button based on selection state."""
        enabled_items = [it for it in self._get_all_checkable_items() if it.isEnabled()]
        is_anything_checked = any(item.checkState() != Qt.CheckState.Unchecked for item in enabled_items)
    
        if is_anything_checked:
            icon_name = 'mdi.checkbox-multiple-blank-outline' 
            tooltip = "Deselect All"
        else:
            icon_name = 'mdi.checkbox-multiple-marked-outline'
            tooltip = "Select All (respecting limits)"
        
        self.toggle_select_button.setIcon(qta.icon(icon_name, color='grey'))
        self.toggle_select_button.setToolTip(tooltip)

    def _show_changes_list_context_menu(self, pos): pass
    
    def _start_token_count_scan(self):
        if not self.project_path: return
        log.info(f"Starting token count scan for {self.project_path}")
        self.folder_token_counts.clear()
        worker = FolderSizeWorker(self.project_path)
        worker.signals.finished.connect(self._on_scan_worker_finished)
        self.threadpool.start(worker)

    def _on_scan_worker_finished(self, path, total_size, total_tokens, file_data):
        log.info(f"Token count scan finished for {path}.")
        if total_size == -1:  # Error case
            log.error("FolderSizeWorker reported an error.")
            return

        # Step 1: Populate folder_token_counts and update UI for all files
        for filepath, (_size, token_count, is_binary) in file_data.items():
            if is_binary: token_count = 0
            norm_path = os.path.normpath(filepath)
            self.folder_token_counts[norm_path] = token_count
            
            if item := self.path_to_item_map.get(norm_path):
                is_large = token_count < 0 or abs(token_count) >= LARGE_TOKEN_COUNT
                
                item_data = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) or {}
                item_data['is_large'] = is_large
                item.setData(item_data, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)

                if is_large:
                    item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)
                    item.setEnabled(False) 
                    display_tokens = f"{abs(token_count):,}+" if token_count < 0 else f"{token_count:,}"
                    item.setToolTip(f"File is too large ({display_tokens} tokens) and has been excluded from selection.")
                    item.setIcon(qta.icon('fa5s.ban', color='red'))

                self._update_item_text(item, token_count)

        # Step 2: Now that all file data is present, calculate folder totals
        self._recalculate_all_folder_counts()

    def _recalculate_all_folder_counts(self):
        log.info("Recalculating all folder token counts...")
        items_to_process = []
        # Correct iteration for QStandardItemModel
        root = self.file_model.invisibleRootItem()
        stack = [root.child(i) for i in range(root.rowCount())]
        while stack:
            item = stack.pop(0)
            if not item: continue
            items_to_process.append(item)
            if item.hasChildren():
                stack.extend(item.child(j) for j in range(item.rowCount()))

        for item in reversed(items_to_process):
            data = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
            if data and data.get('is_dir'):
                path = data.get('path')
                if not path: continue
                total_tokens = sum(abs(self.folder_token_counts.get(os.path.normpath(child.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole).get('path')), 0))
                                   for i in range(item.rowCount()) if (child := item.child(i)) and child.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole))
                self.folder_token_counts[os.path.normpath(path)] = total_tokens
                self._update_item_text(item, total_tokens)
        self._update_total_token_count()
        
    def _update_item_text(self, item: QStandardItem, token_count: int):
        data = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        if not data: return
        base_name = os.path.basename(data.get('path', ''))
        
        token_text = ""
        if token_count < 0:
            token_text = f" ({FolderSizeWorker.TOKEN_COUNT_LIMIT:,}+ tokens)"
        elif token_count > 0:
            token_text = f" ({token_count:,} tokens)"

        item.setText(f"{base_name}{token_text}")

    def _update_total_token_count(self):
        total_tokens = sum(abs(self.folder_token_counts.get(os.path.normpath(path), 0)) for path in self._get_checked_paths())
        self.total_tokens_label.setText(f"Selected tokens: {total_tokens:,}")
        
    def _save_checked_paths(self):
        """Saves the current file selection for the active project."""
        self.save_selection_timer.stop()
        if not self.project_path: return
        settings = self.api.get_manager("settings")
        project_selections = settings.get("ai_studio_selections", {})
        checked_paths = self._get_checked_paths()
        project_selections[os.path.normpath(self.project_path)] = [os.path.normpath(p) for p in checked_paths]
        settings.set("ai_studio_selections", project_selections, False)
        settings.save()
        log.info(f"AI Studio: Saved selection of {len(checked_paths)} items for project '{os.path.basename(self.project_path)}'.")

    def _load_and_apply_checked_paths(self):
        if not self.project_path: return
        
        settings = self.api.get_manager("settings")
        project_selections = settings.get("ai_studio_selections", {})
        saved_paths = project_selections.get(os.path.normpath(self.project_path))
        
        if saved_paths is None:
            log.info("AI Studio: No saved selection to load for this project.")
            return

        self._is_updating_checks = True

        saved_paths_norm = {os.path.normpath(p) for p in saved_paths}
        all_items = []
        
        # FIX: Correctly iterate QStandardItemModel instead of using QTreeWidgetItemIterator
        root = self.file_model.invisibleRootItem()
        q = [root.child(i) for i in range(root.rowCount())]
        while q:
            item = q.pop(0)
            if not item: continue
            all_items.append(item)
            if item.hasChildren():
                q.extend(item.child(j) for j in range(item.rowCount()))

        for item in all_items:
            if item.isCheckable() and item.isEnabled():
                path = (item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) or {}).get('path')
                if path and os.path.normpath(path) in saved_paths_norm:
                    item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked)
                else:
                    item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)

        for item in reversed(all_items):
            if item.parent():
                self._update_parent_checkstate(item.parent())

        self._is_updating_checks = False

        self._update_total_token_count()
        self._update_toggle_button_state()
        log.info(f"AI Studio: Loaded selection for project '{os.path.basename(self.project_path)}'.")

# /plugins/ai_suite/api_client.py
import requests
import json
from typing import Dict, Tuple, TYPE_CHECKING
from utils.logger import log

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from app_core.settings_manager import SettingsManager

class ApiClient:
    """A client to interact with various AI model APIs."""

    PROVIDER_CONFIG = {
        "OpenAI": {
            "endpoint": "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
            "models": ["gpt-4o", "gpt-4-turbo", "gpt-3.5-turbo"],
            "api_key_required": True
        },
        "Ollama": {
            "endpoint": "http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions",
            "models": ["deepseek-coder-v2:lite", "codellama", "llama3"],
            "api_key_required": False
        }
    }

    def __init__(self, settings_manager: "SettingsManager"):
        self.settings_manager = settings_manager

    def get_api_key(self, provider: str) -> str | None:
        """Retrieves an API key for a given provider from settings."""
        if not self.PROVIDER_CONFIG.get(provider, {}).get("api_key_required", True):
            return "ollama"  # Return a dummy non-empty string for providers that don't need a key
        
        api_keys = self.settings_manager.get("api_keys", {})
        return api_keys.get(provider)

    def send_request(
        self, provider: str, model: str, system_prompt: str, user_prompt: str
    ) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """
        Sends a request to the specified AI provider.

        Returns a tuple: (success: bool, response_content: str)
        """
        api_key = self.get_api_key(provider)
        if not api_key:
            msg = (
                f"API Key for {provider} not found. Please configure it in "
                "the settings."
            )
            return False, msg

        config = self.PROVIDER_CONFIG.get(provider)
        if not config:
            return False, f"Configuration for provider '{provider}' not found."

        headers = {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        }
        if provider != "Ollama":
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {api_key}"

        payload = {
            "model": model,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
                {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
            ],
        }
        
        if provider != "Ollama":
            payload["max_tokens"] = 4096

        try:
            log.info(f"Sending request to {provider} model {model}...")
            response = requests.post(
                config["endpoint"],
                headers=headers,
                data=json.dumps(payload),
                timeout=120  # 2-minute timeout
            )
            response.raise_for_status()

            data = response.json()
            content = data['choices'][0]['message']['content']
            log.info("Successfully received response from AI.")
            return True, content.strip()

        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
            if provider == "Ollama":
                error_message = f"API request to Ollama failed. Is the Ollama application running?\n\nDetails: {e}"
            else:
                error_message = f"API request failed: {e}"

            if hasattr(e, 'response') and e.response is not None:
                error_message += f"\nResponse: {e.response.text}"
            log.error(error_message)
            return False, error_message
        except (KeyError, IndexError) as e:
            error_message = f"Failed to parse AI response: {e}"
            if 'response' in locals() and hasattr(response, 'text'):
                log.error(f"{error_message}\nFull Response: {response.text}")
            else:
                log.error(f"{error_message}")
            return False, error_message
        except Exception as e:
            error_message = f"An unexpected error occurred: {e}"
            log.error(error_message, exc_info=True)
            return False, error_message

from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QFormLayout, QLineEdit,

from app_core import golden_rules

class NewAIProjectDialog(QDialog):
    """A dialog to create a prompt for generating a new project."""
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("New Project from AI")
        self.setMinimumWidth(500)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        form_layout = QFormLayout()

        self.project_name_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.project_name_edit.setPlaceholderText("e.g., My Awesome App")
        
        self.instructions_edit = QTextEdit()
        self.instructions_edit.setPlaceholderText("Describe your new application. For example:\n"
                                                  "\"Create a simple PyQt6 app that shows a button. "
                                                  "When clicked, the button's text should change.\"")

        form_layout.addRow("<b>Project Name:</b>", self.project_name_edit)
        form_layout.addRow("<b>Instructions:</b>", self.instructions_edit)
        layout.addLayout(form_layout)

        button_bar = QHBoxLayout()
        button_bar.addStretch()
        self.generate_button = QPushButton(qta.icon('fa5s.copy'), "Generate & Copy Prompt")
        self.cancel_button = QPushButton("Cancel")
        button_bar.addWidget(self.cancel_button)
        button_bar.addWidget(self.generate_button)
        layout.addLayout(button_bar)
        
        self.generate_button.clicked.connect(self._generate_prompt)
        self.cancel_button.clicked.connect(self.reject)
    
    def _generate_prompt(self):
        project_name = self.project_name_edit.text().strip()
        instructions = self.instructions_edit.toPlainText().strip()

        if not project_name or not instructions:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Missing Information",
                                "Project Name and Instructions are required.")
            return

        system_prompt = "\n".join([
            "You are an expert software developer specializing in rapid project scaffolding. Your purpose is to take a user's high-level idea and generate a complete, logical, and runnable project structure with clean boilerplate code.",
            "Your response MUST start with the `## Project Name: <name>` from the user prompt.",
            "Your output MUST ONLY be a series of file blocks, each containing the complete code for that file, conforming to the Golden Rules.",
            "\n## Formatting & Output Rules (Golden Rules)"
        ] + [f"- {rule}" for rule in golden_rules.get_golden_rules()])

        user_prompt_lines = [
            "# New Project Request",
            "",
            f"## Project Name: {project_name}",
            "",
            "## User Instructions",
            "```text",
            instructions,
            "```"
        ]
        user_prompt = "\n".join(user_prompt_lines)
        
        full_prompt = f"---SYSTEM-PROMPT---\n\n{system_prompt.strip()}\n\n---USER-PROMPT---\n\n{user_prompt.strip()}"
        QApplication.clipboard().setText(full_prompt)
        QMessageBox.information(self, "Prompt Copied",
                                "The prompt has been copied to your clipboard. "
                                "Paste it into your AI model to generate the project.")
        self.accept()

# /plugins/ai_suite/persona_logic.py
import os
from typing import List, Optional

def get_files_for_persona(persona_id: str, project_root: str) -> Optional[List[str]]:
    """
    Gets a list of recommended files to select for a given persona.
    Returns a list of files for personas with specific needs, or None for personas
    that should default to including all project files.
    """
    
    file_list = []
    has_specific_logic = False
    
    # Common traversal logic to get all files first.
    all_project_files = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(project_root):
        # Prune ignored directories
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ['__pycache__', '.git', 'venv', '.venv', 'dist', 'build', 'node_modules']]
        for file in files:
            all_project_files.append(os.path.normpath(os.path.join(root, file)))

    # Logic for "Dr. Anya Sharma" - The Architect
    if persona_id == "anya_the_architect":
        has_specific_logic = True
        patterns = ['main.py', 'app_core/', 'ui/main_window.py', 'plugins/']
        for file_path in all_project_files:
            relative_path = os.path.relpath(file_path, project_root).replace("\\", "/")
            if any(relative_path.startswith(p) for p in patterns):
                file_list.append(file_path)

    # Logic for "Sofia Reyes" - The UX Visionary
    elif persona_id == "sofia_the_ux_visionary":
        has_specific_logic = True
        patterns = ['ui/', '.qss', '.css', '.html']
        for file_path in all_project_files:
            relative_path = os.path.relpath(file_path, project_root).replace("\\", "/")
            if any(relative_path.startswith(p) for p in patterns if p.endswith('/')) or \
               any(relative_path.endswith(p) for p in patterns if not p.endswith('/')):
                file_list.append(file_path)

    # Logic for "Glitch" - The QA Maverick
    elif persona_id == "glitch_the_qa_maverick":
        has_specific_logic = True
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(project_root):
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if 'test' not in d.lower() and d not in ['__pycache__', '.git', 'venv', '.venv']]
            for file in files:
                if file.endswith('.py') and not file.startswith('test_'):
                    file_list.append(os.path.normpath(os.path.join(root, file)))

    # Logic for "Eva the Sentinel" - The Security Expert
    elif persona_id == "eva_the_sentinel":
        has_specific_logic = True
        patterns = ['.py', '.json', 'requirements.txt', '.cfg', '.ini', '.lock']
        for file_path in all_project_files:
             if any(file_path.endswith(p) for p in patterns):
                 file_list.append(file_path)

    if not has_specific_logic:
        return None
    
    return sorted(list(set(file_list)))

    def _populate_personas_list(self, select_id=None):
        self.personas_list.clear()
        persona_dir = os.path.join(get_base_path(), "assets", "ai_personas")
        if os.path.isdir(persona_dir):
            for filename in sorted(os.listdir(persona_dir)):
                if filename.endswith(".py") and not filename.startswith("__"):
                    persona_id = os.path.splitext(filename)[0]
                    item = QListWidgetItem(persona_id)
                    item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, os.path.join(persona_dir, filename))
                    self.personas_list.addItem(item)
                    if persona_id == select_id:
                        self.personas_list.setCurrentItem(item)
        if not select_id and self.personas_list.count() > 0:
            self.personas_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _on_persona_selected(self, current, previous):
        if current:
            filepath = current.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
            try:
                with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    self.persona_editor_edit.setPlainText(f.read())
            except Exception as e:
                self.persona_editor_edit.setPlainText(f"# Error reading {os.path.basename(filepath)}\n# {e}")
    
    def _action_new_persona(self):
        name, ok = QInputDialog.getText(self, "New Persona", "Enter persona name (e.g., 'Anya the Architect'):")
        if not (ok and name): return
        
        file_name = name.lower().replace(" ", "_").replace("'", "")
        file_name = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9_]', '', file_name)
        
        persona_dir = os.path.join(get_base_path(), "assets", "ai_personas")
        filepath = os.path.join(persona_dir, f"{file_name}.py")

        if os.path.exists(filepath):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "File Exists", f"A file named '{file_name}.py' already exists.")
            return

        content = PERSONA_TEMPLATE.format(
            file_name=file_name,
            name=name,
            title="The Specialist",
            expertise="...",
            description="A new persona.",
            system_prompt_logic="You are a helpful assistant."
        )
        try:
            with open(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(content.strip())
            self._populate_personas_list(select_id=file_name)
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Could not create persona file: {e}")

    def _action_delete_persona(self):
        current = self.personas_list.currentItem()
        if not current: return
        filepath = current.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        
        if QMessageBox.question(self, "Confirm Delete", f"Delete '{current.text()}'?") == QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            try:
                os.remove(filepath)
                self._populate_personas_list()
            except Exception as e:
                QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Could not delete persona file: {e}")

    def _action_save_persona(self):
        current_item = self.personas_list.currentItem()
        if not current_item:

        filepath = current_item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        content = self.persona_editor_edit.toPlainText()
        try:

                f.write(content)
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Success", f"Saved '{os.path.basename(filepath)}'.\nA restart may be needed for changes to apply.")
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", f"Failed to save file: {e}")

    def _populate_presets_list(self, select_id=None):
        self.presets_list.clear()
        for preset_id, name in self.preset_manager.get_preset_names_for_ui():
            item = QListWidgetItem(name)
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, preset_id)
            self.presets_list.addItem(item)
        if select_id:
            for i in range(self.presets_list.count()):
                if self.presets_list.item(i).data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) == select_id:
                    self.presets_list.setCurrentRow(i)
                    break
        elif self.presets_list.count() > 0:
            self.presets_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _on_preset_selected(self, current, _=None):
        if not current:
            self.preset_name_edit.clear()
            self.preset_desc_edit.clear()
            self.preset_rules_edit.clear()
            self.preset_name_edit.setEnabled(False)
            self.preset_desc_edit.setEnabled(False)
            self.preset_rules_edit.setEnabled(False)
            return
        
        preset_id = current.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        data = self.preset_manager.presets.get(preset_id, {})
        self.preset_name_edit.setText(data.get("name", ""))
        self.preset_desc_edit.setText(data.get("description", ""))
        self.preset_rules_edit.setPlainText("\n".join(data.get("rules", [])))
        self.preset_name_edit.setEnabled(True)
        self.preset_desc_edit.setEnabled(True)
        self.preset_rules_edit.setEnabled(True)

    def _action_new_preset(self):
        name, ok = QInputDialog.getText(self, "New Style Preset", "Enter preset name:")
        if ok and name:
            preset_id = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
            if preset_id in self.preset_manager.presets:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "Preset Exists", "A preset with that ID already exists.")
                return
            
            new_data = {"name": name, "description": "A new custom style preset.", "rules": []}
            if self.preset_manager.save_preset(preset_id, new_data):
                self._populate_presets_list(select_id=preset_id)
            else:
                QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Could not save the new preset.")

    def _action_delete_preset(self):
        current = self.presets_list.currentItem()
        if not current: return
        preset_id = current.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        if QMessageBox.question(self, "Confirm Delete", f"Delete '{current.text()}'?") == QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            if self.preset_manager.delete_preset(preset_id):
                self._populate_presets_list()
            else:
                QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Could not delete the preset.")

    def _action_save_preset(self):
        current = self.presets_list.currentItem()
        if not current: return
        preset_id = current.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        
        data = {
            "name": self.preset_name_edit.text(),
            "description": self.preset_desc_edit.toPlainText(),
            "rules": [line for line in self.preset_rules_edit.toPlainText().splitlines() if line.strip()]
        }
        
        if self.preset_manager.save_preset(preset_id, data):
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Success", "Preset saved.")
            self._populate_presets_list(select_id=preset_id)
        else:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Could not save the preset.")

    def _save_golden_rules(self):
        if golden_rules.save_golden_rules_from_text(self.golden_rules_edit.toPlainText()):
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Success", "Golden Rules saved.")
        else:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Failed to save Golden Rules.")
            
    def _reset_golden_rules(self):
        if QMessageBox.question(self, "Confirm Reset", "Reset to default?", QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No) == QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            if golden_rules.reset_golden_rules_to_default():
                self.golden_rules_edit.setPlainText(golden_rules.get_golden_rules_text())
                QMessageBox.information(self, "Success", "Golden Rules reset.")
            else:
                QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Failed to reset Golden Rules.")

    def update_theme(self):
        colors = self.theme_manager.current_theme_data.get('colors', {})
        bg = colors.get("window.background", "#2d2d2d")
        text = colors.get("editor.foreground", "#cccccc")

        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QDialog {{ background-color: {bg}; color: {text}; }}
            QGroupBox {{ background-color: {pane_bg}; border: 1px solid {border}; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 6px; }}
            QGroupBox::title {{ subcontrol-origin: margin; left: 10px; padding: 0 4px; }}

                background-color: {input_bg};
                border: 1px solid {border};
                border-radius: 4px;
                padding: 4px;
                color: {text};
            }}

                border: none; background: {scrollbar_bg}; width: 12px; margin: 0;
            }}

                background: {scrollbar_handle}; min-height: 25px; border-radius: 6px;
            }}
            QScrollBar::handle:vertical:hover {{ background: {scrollbar_handle_hover}; }}
            QScrollBar::add-line:vertical, QScrollBar::sub-line:vertical {{ height: 0px; }}
            QScrollBar::add-page:vertical, QScrollBar::sub-page:vertical {{ background: none; }}
            QScrollBar:horizontal {{
                border: none; background: {scrollbar_bg}; height: 12px; margin: 0;
            }}
            QScrollBar::handle:horizontal {{
                background: {scrollbar_handle}; min-width: 25px; border-radius: 6px;

# /plugins/ai_suite/plugin_main.py
import os
from functools import partial
from typing import List
from datetime import datetime
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QMenu, QApplication, QMessageBox
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
import qtawesome as qta
from app_core.koromali_api import KoromaliPluginAPI
from app_core import golden_rules
from .ai_studio_dialog import AIStudioDialog

from utils.helpers import clean_git_conflict_markers, get_base_path


class AISuitePlugin:
    def __init__(self, koromali_api: KoromaliPluginAPI):
        self.api = koromali_api
        self.main_window = self.api.get_main_window()
        self.studio_dialog_instance = None 

        tools_menu = self.api.get_menu("tools")
        if tools_menu:
            tools_menu.addSeparator()

        self.api.add_menu_action(
            menu_name="tools",
            text="AI Studio...",
            callback=self.show_studio_dialog,
            icon_name="fa5s.robot"
        )
        
        file_menu = self.api.get_menu("file")
        if file_menu:
            new_project_action = self.main_window.actions.get("create_project")
            self.api.add_menu_action(
                menu_name="file",
                text="New Project from AI...",
                callback=self._show_new_project_dialog,
                icon_name="fa5s.magic",
                insert_before=new_project_action
            )
        
        # --- NEW: Submenu for example prompts ---
        if not hasattr(self.main_window, 'ai_suite_menu'):
            self.main_window.ai_suite_menu = self.api.get_menu("tools").addMenu("AI Suite")
        
        example_action = self.main_window.ai_suite_menu.addAction(
            qta.icon('fa5s.puzzle-piece'), "Copy New Plugin Prompt Example"
        )
        example_action.triggered.connect(self._copy_new_plugin_prompt)

        self._integrate_context_menu()
        log.info("AI Suite plugin initialized.")

    def _integrate_context_menu(self):
        """Adds a new action to the file explorer's context menu."""
        if hasattr(self.main_window, 'explorer_panel'):
            explorer_tree = self.main_window.explorer_panel.tree_widget
            explorer_tree.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._on_explorer_context_menu)
            log.info("AI Suite successfully integrated with explorer context menu.")
        else:
            log.warning("Could not find 'explorer_panel' to integrate context menu.")
    
    def _on_explorer_context_menu(self, position):
        """Dynamically adds the 'Copy as AI Prompt' action to the menu."""
        explorer_tree = self.main_window.explorer_panel.tree_widget
        selected_items = explorer_tree.selectedItems()
        
        if len(selected_items) != 1: return
            
        item = selected_items[0]
        data = item.data(0, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        is_dir = data.get('is_dir', False)
        
        menu = explorer_tree.findChild(QMenu)
        if not menu or is_dir: return
            
        menu.addSeparator()
        ai_action = menu.addAction(qta.icon('fa5s.paper-plane'), "Copy as AI Prompt")
        ai_action.triggered.connect(partial(self._export_single_file_to_clipboard, data.get('path')))

    def _export_single_file_to_clipboard(self, filepath: str):
        if not filepath: return
            
        try:
            with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                content = clean_git_conflict_markers(f.read())
            
            relative_path = os.path.relpath(filepath, self.api.get_manager("project").get_active_project_path()).replace("\\", "/")
            lang = os.path.splitext(filepath)[1].lstrip('.') or 'text'
            
            formatted_text = "\n".join([f"### File: `/{relative_path}`", f"```{lang}", content, "```"])

            QApplication.clipboard().setText(formatted_text)
            self.api.show_status_message(f"'{os.path.basename(filepath)}' prompt copied!", 3000)
            
        except Exception as e:
            log.error(f"Failed to copy file as prompt: {e}", exc_info=True)
            self.api.show_message("critical", "Copy Failed", f"Could not read file: {e}")

    def show_studio_dialog(self):
        """Shows the AI Studio as a persistent, non-modal window."""
        if self.studio_dialog_instance is None or not self.studio_dialog_instance.isVisible():
            self.studio_dialog_instance = AIStudioDialog(self.api, self.main_window)
            self.studio_dialog_instance.project_context_locked.connect(
                lambda path, locked: self.api.project_lock_requested.emit(path, locked)
            )

        self.studio_dialog_instance.show()
        self.studio_dialog_instance.raise_()
        self.studio_dialog_instance.activateWindow()
        
    def _show_new_project_dialog(self):
        """Shows the dialog for creating a new project from an AI prompt."""
        dialog = NewAIProjectDialog(self.main_window)
        dialog.exec()
        
    def _copy_new_plugin_prompt(self):
        """Generates a prompt for creating a new plugin and copies it."""
        try:
            plugin_main_content, _ = self.api.get_main_window().file_handler._read_with_encoding_detection(os.path.join(get_base_path(), "plugins/ai_suite/plugin_main.py"))
            plugin_json_content, _ = self.api.get_main_window().file_handler._read_with_encoding_detection(os.path.join(get_base_path(), "plugins/ai_suite/plugin.json"))
            
            prompt_parts = [
                "# Project Task",
                "## User Instructions",
                "```text",
                'Create a new plugin for the Koromali IDE called "My New Plugin". This plugin will live inside the \'plugins\' directory.',
                "- The new plugin's subdirectory should be named 'my_new_plugin'.",
                "- Its `plugin.json` should have the ID 'my_new_plugin' and author 'AI Developer'.",
                '- The plugin should add a new menu item to the "Tools" menu called "Show Info".',
                '- When clicked, this menu item should show an informational QMessageBox with the text "Hello from My New Plugin!".',
                "- Use the provided files as a reference for the required structure. You only need to create the files for the new plugin inside the 'plugins/my_new_plugin/' directory.",
                "```",
                "## Project Files",
                "### File: `/plugins/ai_suite/plugin_main.py`",
                "```python",
                plugin_main_content,
                "```",
                "### File: `/plugins/ai_suite/plugin.json`",
                "```json",
                plugin_json_content,
                "```"
            ]
            prompt = "\n".join(prompt_parts)

            QApplication.clipboard().setText(prompt.strip())
            self.api.show_status_message("Example new plugin prompt copied to clipboard!", 4000)

        except Exception as e:
            log.error(f"Failed to generate example prompt: {e}", exc_info=True)
            self.api.show_message("critical", "Error", "Could not generate the example prompt. Check that reference files exist.")

    def perform_backup_export(self, project_path: str, file_list: List[str]):
        """
        Performs an AI export with default settings, intended as a quick backup.
        """
        log.info(f"Performing backup export for project: {project_path}")
        if not file_list:
            self.api.show_message("info", "Export Empty", "No files selected or found for the export.")
            return

        project_name = os.path.basename(project_path)
        export_dir = os.path.join(get_base_path(), "ai_exports", project_name)
        
        try:
            os.makedirs(export_dir, exist_ok=True)
            timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S")
            filename = f"backup_export_{timestamp}.md"
            output_filepath = os.path.join(export_dir, filename)

            project_manager = self.api.get_manager("project")
            
            # Use default golden rules. No specific style preset needed for a backup.
            rules = golden_rules.get_golden_rules()

            success, message = project_manager.export_project_for_ai(
                output_filepath=output_filepath,
                selected_files=file_list,
                instructions="This is a full project backup for analysis. Review all files.",
                guidelines=[],
                golden_rules=rules,
                all_problems=None # No linter for this quick backup
            )
            
            if success:
                QMessageBox.information(
                    self.main_window,
                    "Export Successful",
                    f"Backup created successfully at:\n{output_filepath}"
                )
            else:
                raise IOError(message)

        except Exception as e:
            log.error(f"Failed during backup export: {e}", exc_info=True)
            self.api.show_message("critical", "Export Failed", f"Could not create the backup export file:\n{e}")

def initialize(koromali_api: KoromaliPluginAPI):
    """Entry point for Koromali to load the plugin."""
    return AISuitePlugin(koromali_api)

# /plugins/ai_suite/response_parser.py
import os
import re
import shutil
from typing import Dict, Tuple, Any, Optional
from utils.logger import log


def apply_patch(original_content: str, patch_content: str) -> str:
    """
    Applies a unified diff patch to a string content, resilient to
    line ending and leading/trailing whitespace differences.
    """
    # Normalize line endings of both original and patch to LF for processing
    original_lines = original_content.replace('\r\n', '\n').splitlines()
    patch_lines = patch_content.replace('\r\n', '\n').splitlines()
    
    # Detect original ending to restore it later
    original_ending = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in original_content else '\n'

    output_lines = []
    original_line_idx = 0
    patch_idx = 0
    hunk_pattern = re.compile(r'^@@ -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@.*$')

    # Skip header lines of the patch (---, +++)
    while patch_idx < len(patch_lines) and not hunk_pattern.match(patch_lines[patch_idx]):
        patch_idx += 1

    while patch_idx < len(patch_lines):
        line = patch_lines[patch_idx]
        match = hunk_pattern.match(line)
        if not match:
            patch_idx += 1
            continue

        old_start = int(match.group(1))
        old_start_idx = max(0, old_start - 1)
        
        output_lines.extend(original_lines[original_line_idx:old_start_idx])
        original_line_idx = old_start_idx
        
        patch_idx += 1
        
        while patch_idx < len(patch_lines) and not patch_lines[patch_idx].startswith('@@'):
            hunk_line = patch_lines[patch_idx]
            if not hunk_line:
                # Handle cases where patch includes a completely empty line for context
                op, data = ' ', ''
            else:
                op, data = hunk_line[0], hunk_line[1:]

            # Robust comparison that ignores only TRAILING whitespace to preserve indentation
            def check_match(original_idx, patch_data):
                if original_idx >= len(original_lines):
                    return False
                return original_lines[original_idx].rstrip() == patch_data.rstrip()
            
            if op == '+':
                output_lines.append(data)
            elif op == '-':
                if not check_match(original_line_idx, data):
                    expected = original_lines[original_line_idx] if original_line_idx < len(original_lines) else "[End of File]"
                    raise ValueError(f"Patch mismatch at original line {original_line_idx + 1}.\nExpected: '{expected}'\nFound in patch: '{data}'")
                original_line_idx += 1
            elif op == ' ':
                if not check_match(original_line_idx, data):
                     expected = original_lines[original_line_idx] if original_line_idx < len(original_lines) else "[End of File]"
                     raise ValueError(f"Patch context mismatch at original line {original_line_idx + 1}.\nExpected: '{expected}'\nFound in patch: '{data}'")
                output_lines.append(original_lines[original_line_idx])
                original_line_idx += 1
            elif op == '\\':
                pass # Ignore '\ No newline at end of file' lines
            else:
                 raise ValueError(f"Invalid patch format: unexpected line prefix '{op}' in hunk.")

            patch_idx += 1
            
    output_lines.extend(original_lines[original_line_idx:])
    return original_ending.join(output_lines)


def parse_llm_response(response_text: str) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:
    """
    Parses a markdown response from an LLM. It identifies an explicit project
    name header for new project creation and handles file modifications, creations,
    deletions, and moves.
    """
    changes: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
    project_name: Optional[str] = None

    name_match = re.search(r"^##\s+(?:Project Name|Target Project):\s*(.+?)$", response_text, re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE)
    if name_match:
        project_name = name_match.group(1).strip()
        log.info(f"AI Patcher: Detected explicit project context for '{project_name}'.")
    
    # This pattern finds the file path, handling optional backticks. It captures until the end of the line.
    header_pattern = re.compile(r"^### File:\s*(?P<path>.*)$", re.MULTILINE)
    header_matches = list(header_pattern.finditer(response_text))
    
    if not header_matches:
        log.warning("AI Patcher: No `### File:` blocks were found in the AI response.")
        return project_name, {}

    for i, header_match in enumerate(header_matches):
        # Clean up path: strip whitespace and surrounding backticks
        path = header_match.group("path").strip()
        if path.startswith('`') and path.endswith('`'):
            path = path[1:-1]
        path = path.lstrip('/')

        if not path or path == ".":
            log.warning(f"AI Patcher: Ignoring file block with invalid path: '{path}'")
            continue
            
        start_pos = header_match.end()
        end_pos = header_matches[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(header_matches) else len(response_text)
        
        content_block_raw = response_text[start_pos:end_pos]
        content_block_stripped = content_block_raw.strip()

        if content_block_stripped.startswith("---DELETED---"):
            changes[path] = {'content': None, 'type': 'delete'}
            log.info(f"AI Patcher: Parsed DELETE request for '{path}'.")
            continue
            
        move_match = re.match(r"^---MOVED-TO:\s*`?(?P<path>/[^\n`]+?)`?---", content_block_stripped)
        if move_match:
            new_path = move_match.group("path").strip().lstrip('/')
            changes[path] = {'content': new_path, 'type': 'move'}
            log.info(f"AI Patcher: Parsed MOVE request for '{path}' to '{new_path}'.")
            continue

        # This regex now looks for a code block at the beginning of the raw content block.
        # It handles ` ``` ` and `~~~` fences, with multiple backticks supported.
        code_match = re.search(r"^\s*(````*|~~~)\s*(\S*)\n(.*?)\n\1", content_block_raw, re.DOTALL | re.MULTILINE)
        
        if code_match:
            _, lang, content = code_match.groups()
            lang = lang.strip().lower()

            is_diff = (lang == 'diff' or 
                       (content.strip().startswith('--- a/') and '@@ ' in content.strip()))
            
            change_type = 'patch' if is_diff else 'full_file'

            changes[path] = {'content': content, 'type': change_type}
            log.info(f"AI Patcher: Parsed file block for '{path}' as type '{change_type}'.")
        else:
             log.warning(f"AI Patcher: Found file header for '{path}' but no valid code block followed.")


    if not changes:
        log.warning("AI Patcher: No valid file operation blocks were found in the AI response.")
        
    return project_name, changes


def apply_changes_to_project(project_root: str, changes: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]], is_new_project: bool = False) -> Tuple[bool, list]:
    """
    Applies parsed changes to the project.
    Returns a tuple: (success: bool, errors_or_message: list|str)
    If success is False, the second element is a list of error dictionaries.
    """
    if not project_root:
        return False, [{"path": "Unknown", "error": "Project root path was not specified."}]
    
    if not changes:
        return False, [{"path": "Unknown", "error": "No file changes were provided to apply."}]

    materialized_changes = {}
    errors = []

    log.info("AI Patcher: Stage 1/2 - Preparing 'snapshot' of all file changes...")
    for rel_path, change_data in changes.items():
        clean_rel_path = rel_path.lstrip('/').lstrip('\\')
        abs_path = os.path.join(project_root, clean_rel_path)
        
        change_type = change_data.get('type')
        if change_type == 'patch':
            original_content = ""
            try:
                if os.path.exists(abs_path):
                    with open(abs_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8-sig', errors='ignore') as f:
                        original_content = f.read()
                new_content = apply_patch(original_content, change_data['content'])
                materialized_changes[clean_rel_path] = {'content': new_content, 'type': 'full_file'}
            except (ValueError, IndexError) as e:
                err_info = {
                    "path": clean_rel_path, "error": str(e),
                    "original_content": original_content, "patch_content": change_data['content']
                }
                errors.append(err_info)
                log.error(f"AI Patcher: {err_info['error']}", exc_info=True)
        else:
            materialized_changes[clean_rel_path] = change_data

    if errors:
        return False, errors

    log.info(f"AI Patcher: Stage 2/2 - Applying {len(materialized_changes)} materialized changes...")
    success_count = 0
    for rel_path, change_data in materialized_changes.items():
        abs_path = os.path.join(project_root, rel_path)
        try:
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(abs_path), exist_ok=True)
            if change_data.get('type') == 'delete':
                if os.path.exists(abs_path): os.remove(abs_path)
                success_count += 1
            elif change_data.get('type') == 'move':
                new_rel_path = change_data.get('content')
                new_abs_path = os.path.join(project_root, new_rel_path)
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(new_abs_path), exist_ok=True)
                if os.path.exists(abs_path):
                    shutil.move(abs_path, new_abs_path)
                    success_count += 1
                else:
                    errors.append({"path": rel_path, "error": "Source file for move does not exist."})
            else: # full_file
                content_to_write = change_data.get('content', '')
                with open(abs_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
                    f.write(content_to_write)
                success_count += 1
        except (IOError, OSError) as e:
            errors.append({"path": rel_path, "error": str(e)})

    if errors:
        return False, errors

    return True, f"Successfully processed {success_count} file change(s)."

# /plugins/ai_suite/style_preset_manager.py
import os
import json
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from utils.logger import log
from utils.helpers import get_base_path

PRESETS_DIR = os.path.join(get_base_path(), "assets", "style_presets")

class StylePresetManager:
    """Handles loading, saving, and managing Style Presets."""

    def __init__(self):
        self._ensure_presets_dir_exists()
        self.presets = self.load_presets()

    def _ensure_presets_dir_exists(self):
        """Creates the style_presets directory if it doesn't exist."""
        if not os.path.isdir(PRESETS_DIR):
            try:
                os.makedirs(PRESETS_DIR)
                log.info(f"Created style presets directory: {PRESETS_DIR}")
            except OSError as e:
                log.error(f"Failed to create presets directory: {e}")

    def load_presets(self) -> Dict[str, Dict]:
        """
        Loads all .json files from the presets directory into a dictionary.
        """
        loaded_presets = {}
        if not os.path.isdir(PRESETS_DIR):
            return {}

        for filename in sorted(os.listdir(PRESETS_DIR)):
            if filename.endswith(".json"):
                preset_id = os.path.splitext(filename)[0]
                filepath = os.path.join(PRESETS_DIR, filename)
                try:
                    with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                        data = json.load(f)
                        if "name" in data and "rules" in data:
                            loaded_presets[preset_id] = data
                        else:
                            log.warning(f"Preset file '{filename}' is missing 'name' or 'rules' key.")
                except (json.JSONDecodeError, IOError) as e:
                    log.error(f"Failed to load preset '{filename}': {e}")
        return loaded_presets

    def get_preset_names_for_ui(self) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
        """Returns a list of (preset_id, preset_name) tuples for UI population."""
        return sorted([(pid, pdata.get("name", pid)) for pid, pdata in self.presets.items()], key=lambda x: x[1])

    def save_preset(self, preset_id: str, data: Dict) -> bool:
        """Saves a single preset to a .json file."""
        filepath = os.path.join(PRESETS_DIR, f"{preset_id}.json")
        try:
            with open(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump(data, f, indent=4)
            log.info(f"Saved preset '{preset_id}'.")
            self.presets = self.load_presets()
            return True
        except IOError as e:
            log.error(f"Failed to save preset '{preset_id}': {e}")
            return False

    def delete_preset(self, preset_id: str) -> bool:
        """Deletes a preset file."""
        filepath = os.path.join(PRESETS_DIR, f"{preset_id}.json")
        if os.path.exists(filepath):
            try:
                os.remove(filepath)
                log.info(f"Deleted preset '{preset_id}'.")
                self.presets = self.load_presets()
                return True
            except OSError as e:
                log.error(f"Failed to delete preset '{preset_id}': {e}")
                return False
        return False

# /plugins/ai_suite/token_cache.py
import os
import json
from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple
from utils.logger import log

class TokenCache:
    """
    Manages a persistent cache for file token counts within a project
    to avoid re-calculating for large files.
    """
    def __init__(self, project_path: str):
        self.project_path = project_path
        self.cache_dir = os.path.join(project_path, ".koromali")
        self.cache_file = os.path.join(self.cache_dir, "token_cache.json")
        self.cache_data: Dict[str, Dict] = self._load()

    def _load(self) -> Dict[str, Dict]:
        """Loads the cache file from disk if it exists."""
        if os.path.exists(self.cache_file):
            try:
                with open(self.cache_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    return json.load().get("files", {})
            except (IOError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
                log.warning(f"Could not load token cache: {e}")
        return {}

    def save(self):
        """Saves the current cache data to disk."""
        try:
            os.makedirs(self.cache_dir, exist_ok=True)
            with open(self.cache_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump({"files": self.cache_data}, f, indent=2)
        except IOError as e:
            log.error(f"Could not save token cache: {e}")

    def get(self, filepath: str) -> Optional[int]:
        """
        Retrieves a token count from the cache if the file hasn't changed.
        
        Returns:
            The cached token count, or None if not in cache or if the file
            has been modified since it was last cached.
        """
        norm_path = os.path.normpath(filepath)
        relative_path = os.path.relpath(norm_path, self.project_path)
        
        if relative_path in self.cache_data:
            cached_entry = self.cache_data[relative_path]
            try:
                # Get current file stats
                stat = os.stat(norm_path)
                
                # Check if modification time and size match the cached values
                if stat.st_mtime == cached_entry.get("mtime") and stat.st_size == cached_entry.get("size"):
                    return cached_entry.get("token_count")
            except FileNotFoundError:
                # The file was deleted, so we should remove it from the cache
                del self.cache_data[relative_path]
        return None

    def set(self, filepath: str, token_count: int):
        """
        Updates the cache with the new token count and file stats for a given file.
        Note: This only updates the in-memory cache. Call save() to persist.
        """
        norm_path = os.path.normpath(filepath)
        relative_path = os.path.relpath(norm_path, self.project_path)
        try:
            stat = os.stat(norm_path)
            self.cache_data[relative_path] = {
                "mtime": stat.st_mtime,
                "size": stat.st_size,
                "token_count": token_count
            }
        except FileNotFoundError:
            log.warning(f"Cannot cache token count for non-existent file: {filepath}")

class WorkerSignals(QObject):
    """Defines signals available from a running worker."""
    finished = pyqtSignal(bool, object)
    error = pyqtSignal(str)


class LargeFileProcessorWorker(QRunnable):
    """
    A dedicated worker to process only large files for token counting
    in the background, one by one.
    """
    class Signals(QObject):
        file_processed = pyqtSignal(str, int)  # filepath, token_count
        finished = pyqtSignal()

    def __init__(self, filepaths: List[str], token_cache: TokenCache):
        super().__init__()
        self.signals = self.Signals()
        self.filepaths = filepaths
        self.token_cache = token_cache
        self.is_cancelled = False

    def run(self):
        for filepath in self.filepaths:
            if self.is_cancelled:
                break
            
            token_count = 0
            try:
                size = os.path.getsize(filepath)
                potential_tokens = size // GenericFolderScanner.TOKEN_ESTIMATE_DIVISOR
                if potential_tokens > GenericFolderScanner.TOKEN_COUNT_LIMIT:
                    token_count = -GenericFolderScanner.TOKEN_COUNT_LIMIT
                else:
                    char_count = 0
                    with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                        while True:
                            chunk = f.read(GenericFolderScanner.CHUNK_SIZE)
                            if not chunk: break
                            char_count += len(chunk)
                            if (char_count // GenericFolderScanner.TOKEN_ESTIMATE_DIVISOR) > GenericFolderScanner.TOKEN_COUNT_LIMIT:
                                token_count = -GenericFolderScanner.TOKEN_COUNT_LIMIT
                                break
                    if token_count == 0:
                        token_count = char_count // GenericFolderScanner.TOKEN_ESTIMATE_DIVISOR

                self.token_cache.set(filepath, token_count)
                self.signals.file_processed.emit(filepath, token_count)

            except Exception as e:
                log.warning(f"Could not process large file {filepath}: {e}")
                self.token_cache.set(filepath, 0) # Cache as 0 if error
                self.signals.file_processed.emit(filepath, 0)
        
        self.token_cache.save()
        self.signals.finished.emit()

    def cancel(self):
        self.is_cancelled = True


class PersonaLoaderWorker(QRunnable):
    """Worker to load AI persona modules from the assets directory."""
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.signals = WorkerSignals()

    def run(self):
        try:
            personas = {}
            modules = {}
            persona_dir = os.path.join(get_base_path(), "assets", "ai_personas")
            if not os.path.isdir(persona_dir):
                self.signals.finished.emit(True, ({}, {}))
                return

            for filename in sorted(os.listdir(persona_dir)):
                if filename.endswith(".py") and not filename.startswith("__"):
                    module_path = os.path.join(persona_dir, filename)
                    module_name = f"assets.ai_personas.{os.path.splitext(filename)[0]}"
                    try:
                        # Invalidate cache to allow reloading
                        if module_name in sys.modules:
                            del sys.modules[module_name]

                        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, module_path)
                        if spec and spec.loader:
                            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                            sys.modules[module_name] = module
                            spec.loader.exec_module(module)
                            if hasattr(module, "get_persona_info"):
                                info = module.get_persona_info()
                                personas[info['id']] = info
                                modules[info['id']] = module
                    except Exception as e:
                        log.error(f"Failed to load AI persona module '{filename}': {e}", exc_info=True)
            self.signals.finished.emit(True, (personas, modules))
        except Exception as e:
            log.error(f"Critical error in PersonaLoaderWorker: {e}", exc_info=True)
            self.signals.finished.emit(False, f"Could not load personas: {e}")


class PromptGenerationWorker(QRunnable):
    """Worker to build the final prompt for the AI."""
    def __init__(self, context: Dict):
        super().__init__()
        self.context = context
        self.signals = WorkerSignals()
        self.personas, self.persona_modules = self._load_personas()

    def run(self):
        try:
            # Prepare context
            selected_paths = self.context.get("selected_paths", [])
            all_files_in_scope = self._expand_paths_to_files(selected_paths)
            text_files_to_read = [f for f in all_files_in_scope if not is_binary_file(f)]
            project_path = self.context.get("project_path")
            self.context["file_contents"] = {path: self._read_file(path) for path in text_files_to_read}
            self.context["file_tree"] = self._generate_file_tree(project_path, all_files_in_scope)
            
            # Generate system and user prompts
            system_prompt = self._build_system_prompt()
            user_prompt = self._build_user_prompt()
            
            full_prompt = f"---SYSTEM-PROMPT---\n\n{system_prompt}\n\n---USER-PROMPT---\n\n{user_prompt}"
            self.signals.finished.emit(True, full_prompt)
        except Exception as e:
            log.error(f"Error during prompt generation: {e}", exc_info=True)
            self.signals.finished.emit(False, f"Error generating prompt: {e}")

    def _build_system_prompt(self) -> str:
        """Constructs the system prompt based on UI settings."""
        use_persona_flag = self.context.get('use_persona', True)
        include_patcher_rules_flag = self.context.get('include_patcher_rules', True)
        persona_id = self.context.get('persona_id')
        style_preset_id = self.context.get('style_preset_id')
        
        system_prompt_parts = []
        
        # 1. Base instructions from persona or generic
        if use_persona_flag and persona_id and (module := self.persona_modules.get(persona_id)):
            persona_system_prompt, _ = module.get_persona_instance().generate_prompt(self.context)
            system_prompt_parts.append(persona_system_prompt)
        else:
            system_prompt_parts.append("You are an expert software developer. Your task is to modify the user's project based on their instructions.")

        # 2. Style preset rules
        if use_persona_flag and style_preset_id:
            preset_manager = StylePresetManager() # Reloads each time to ensure freshness
            if preset := preset_manager.presets.get(style_preset_id):
                if rules := preset.get("rules"):
                    system_prompt_parts.append("\n## Style Guidelines")
                    system_prompt_parts.extend(f"- {rule}" for rule in rules)
        
        # 3. Patcher rules (Golden Rules)
        if include_patcher_rules_flag:
            system_prompt_parts.append("\n## Formatting & Output Rules (Golden Rules)")
            system_prompt_parts.extend(f"- {rule}" for rule in golden_rules.get_golden_rules())

        return "\n".join(system_prompt_parts)

    def _build_user_prompt(self) -> str:
        """Constructs the user prompt containing all project context."""
        file_contents_section = []
        project_name = os.path.basename(self.context.get("project_path", "Unknown Project"))
        
        for path, content in self.context.get("file_contents", {}).items():
            relative_path = os.path.relpath(path, self.context["project_path"]).replace("\\", "/")
            lang = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lstrip('.') or 'text'
            file_contents_section.append(f"### File: `/{relative_path}`\n```{lang}\n{content}\n```")
        
        file_contents_str = "\n\n".join(file_contents_section)

        user_prompt = f"""
# Project Task

## Target Project: {project_name}

## User Instructions
```text
{self.context.get("user_instructions", "Perform a general review based on your expertise.")}
```

## Project File Tree
```{self.context.get("file_tree", "No file tree provided.")}```

## Project Files
{file_contents_str}
"""
        return user_prompt.strip()

    def _expand_paths_to_files(self, paths: List[str]) -> List[str]:
        file_set: Set[str] = set()
        ignore_dirs = {'.git', '__pycache__', 'venv', '.venv', 'ai_exports'}
        for path in paths:
            if os.path.isfile(path):
                file_set.add(path)
            elif os.path.isdir(path):
                for root, dirs, files in os.walk(path, topdown=True):
                    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ignore_dirs]
                    for name in files:
                        file_set.add(os.path.join(root, name))
        return sorted(list(file_set))

    def _read_file(self, path: str) -> str:
        try:
            with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                return f.read()
        except Exception as e:
            return f"[Error reading file: {e}]"

    def _generate_file_tree(self, project_root: str, file_list: list) -> str:
        if not project_root or not file_list: return "No file tree generated."
        tree = {}
        for file_path in file_list:
            node_text = os.path.basename(file_path)
            if is_binary_file(file_path):
                node_text += " [UNSUPPORTED BINARY]"
            relative_path = os.path.relpath(file_path, project_root).replace(os.sep, '/')
            parts = relative_path.split('/')
            parts[-1] = node_text
            current_level = tree
            for part in parts:
                current_level = current_level.setdefault(part, {})
        return "\n".join(self._build_tree_lines(tree, os.path.basename(project_root)))

    def _build_tree_lines(self, d: dict, root_name: str, prefix: str = "") -> list:
        lines = [root_name] if not prefix else []
        entries = sorted(d.keys(), key=lambda k: (not d[k], k.lower()))
        for i, name in enumerate(entries):
            connector = "└── " if i == len(entries) - 1 else "├── "
            lines.append(f"{prefix}{connector}{name}")
            if d[name]:
                new_prefix = prefix + ("    " if i == len(entries) - 1 else "│   ")
                lines.extend(self._build_tree_lines(d[name], "", new_prefix))
        return lines

    def _load_personas(self):
        # This is a bit of a hack to load every time, but ensures freshness
        # if the user edits personas without restarting the dialog.
        personas, modules = {}, {}
        persona_dir = os.path.join(get_base_path(), "assets", "ai_personas")
        for filename in sorted(os.listdir(persona_dir)):
            if filename.endswith(".py") and not filename.startswith("__"):
                module_path = os.path.join(persona_dir, filename)
                module_name = f"assets.ai_personas.{os.path.splitext(filename)[0]}"
                try:
                    if module_name in sys.modules: del sys.modules[module_name]
                    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, module_path)
                    if spec and spec.loader:
                        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                        sys.modules[module_name] = module
                        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
                        if hasattr(module, "get_persona_info"):
                            info = module.get_persona_info()
                            personas[info['id']] = info
                            modules[info['id']] = module
                except Exception as e:
                    log.error(f"Failed to load persona '{filename}': {e}")
        return personas, modules


class APIRequestWorker(QRunnable):
    """Worker that generates a prompt, sends it to the AI, and returns the response."""
    def __init__(self, context: Dict, api_client: ApiClient, provider: str, model: str):
        super().__init__()
        self.signals = WorkerSignals()
        self.context = context
        self.api_client = api_client
        self.provider = provider
        self.model = model

    def run(self):
        try:
            prompt_worker = PromptGenerationWorker(self.context)
            
            # This is a bit of a hack to run the PromptGenerationWorker's logic
            # synchronously within this worker's thread without using signals.
            # We can't easily connect signals and wait here, so we just run its logic.
            prompt = [""] 
            def on_finished(s, r):
                if s: 
                    prompt[0] = r
                else: 
                    self.signals.finished.emit(False, r)
            
            # We temporarily re-assign the worker's signal object to one we control
            temp_signals = WorkerSignals()
            temp_signals.finished.connect(on_finished)
            prompt_worker.signals = temp_signals
            prompt_worker.run() # Run the logic directly.
            
            if not prompt[0]: 
                # An error already will have been emitted by the 'on_finished' callback
                return
                
            system_prompt = re.search(r'---SYSTEM-PROMPT---(.*?)---USER-PROMPT---', prompt[0], re.DOTALL).group(1).strip()
            user_prompt = re.search(r'---USER-PROMPT---(.*)', prompt[0], re.DOTALL).group(1).strip()

            success, response = self.api_client.send_request(
                self.provider, self.model, system_prompt, user_prompt
            )
            self.signals.finished.emit(success, response)
            
        except Exception as e:
            log.error(f"Error during APIRequestWorker execution: {e}", exc_info=True)
            self.signals.finished.emit(False, f"An unexpected error occurred: {e}")


class PatchPreviewWorker(QRunnable):
    """Worker to parse the AI response in the background."""
    def __init__(self, response_text: str):
        super().__init__()
        self.response_text = response_text
        self.signals = WorkerSignals()

    def run(self):
        try:
            # The ~~~ will be replaced with ``` for the parser to correctly handle markdown files.
            processed_text = self.response_text.replace('~~~', '```')
            project_name, parsed_data = parse_llm_response(processed_text)
            self.signals.finished.emit(True, (project_name, parsed_data))
        except Exception as e:
            log.error(f"Error parsing patch response: {e}", exc_info=True)
            self.signals.finished.emit(False, f"Failed to parse response: {e}")


class PatchApplyWorker(QRunnable):
    """Worker to apply changes to the project files."""
    def __init__(self, project_root: str, changes: Dict[str, Dict], is_new_project: bool = False):
        super().__init__()
        self.project_root = project_root
        self.changes = changes
        self.is_new_project = is_new_project
        self.signals = WorkerSignals()
        
    def run(self):
        success, message = apply_changes_to_project(self.project_root, self.changes, self.is_new_project)
        self.signals.finished.emit(success, message)

# Koromali/plugins/api_keys_manager/api_keys_settings_page.py
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QFormLayout, QLineEdit, QHBoxLayout, QPushButton, QLabel,
    QDialogButtonBox, QVBoxLayout
)
import qtawesome as qta


class ApiKeysDialog(QDialog):
    """A dialog for managing API keys."""
    def __init__(self, settings_manager, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.settings_manager = settings_manager

        self.setWindowTitle("Manage API Keys")
        self.setMinimumWidth(500)

        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        form_layout = QFormLayout()

        info_label = QLabel(
            "Enter your API keys below. They are stored locally and securely."
        )
        form_layout.addRow(info_label)

        # Add providers here. We'll start with OpenAI.
        self.openai_key_input, openai_layout = self._create_key_input()
        form_layout.addRow("OpenAI API Key:", openai_layout)

        main_layout.addLayout(form_layout)

        button_box = QDialogButtonBox(
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok |
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel
        )
        main_layout.addWidget(button_box)

        button_box.accepted.connect(self.accept)
        button_box.rejected.connect(self.reject)

        self.load_settings()

    def _create_key_input(self) -> tuple[QLineEdit, QHBoxLayout]:
        """Creates a password-style QLineEdit with a show/hide button."""
        layout = QHBoxLayout()
        line_edit = QLineEdit()
        line_edit.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)

        show_hide_button = QPushButton(qta.icon('fa5s.eye'), "")
        show_hide_button.setCheckable(True)
        show_hide_button.setToolTip("Show/Hide Key")
        show_hide_button.setFixedWidth(30)
        show_hide_button.toggled.connect(
            lambda c: line_edit.setEchoMode(
                QLineEdit.EchoMode.Normal if c
                else QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)
        )

        layout.addWidget(line_edit)
        layout.addWidget(show_hide_button)
        return line_edit, layout

    def load_settings(self):
        """Loads saved API keys into the input fields."""
        keys = self.settings_manager.get("api_keys", {})
        self.openai_key_input.setText(keys.get("OpenAI", ""))

    def save_settings(self):
        """Saves the API keys from the input fields."""
        keys = self.settings_manager.get("api_keys", {})
        keys["OpenAI"] = self.openai_key_input.text()
        self.settings_manager.set("api_keys", keys)
        self.settings_manager.save()

    def accept(self):
        """Saves settings and closes the dialog."""
        self.save_settings()
        super().accept()
